thread:
Arden (Growth): Quick sync 8m9 — launch posts + webinar funnel. Need a tight KW map, JSON-LD for landing, internal link plan from pillar pages, and a safe redirect strategy that preserves UTMs and supports rollback. Who picks what? :spiral_calendar:
Noah-SEO: Ill own the KW map and meta variants. Focusing on long-tail purchase intent + implementation queries. Draft KWs: 'reduce inference latency', 'predictable inference cost', 'inference caching best practices', 'dedicated gpu inference', 'batching for low latency'.
Priya-Dev: Ill handle redirects and canonical fixes. Plan: temp 302 for 48h, monitor conversions, then atomically flip to 301. Will ensure $query_string is preserved.
Sam-Content: I'll write the benchmark blurb and two invite hooks (tech and exec). Short, measurable.
edge-bot: Crawl highlights: 5 pages missing Event schema, 2 redirect chains >2 hops, 1 page with conflicting canonical. Snapshot: https://internal.crawl/1758887776/snapshot
CRM-Team: For forms we will capture utm_source, utm_medium, utm_term into hidden fields: 'kw_term' and 'origin'. Also map region param to SDR queues (NA/EMEA/APAC).
Arden (Growth): Internal linking: prioritize these pillars: 'inference economics', 'runtime optimizations', 'deployment patterns'. Use two anchor variants only: 'predictable inference cost' and 'reduce inference latency'. No links to /pricing from blog flow.
Noah-SEO: Meta A emphasizes cost savings, Meta B emphasizes latency improvement. H1 idea: 'Predictable LLM inference latency and cost'. H2s map to deployment and caching.
Priya-Dev: Redirect snippet (nginx temp -> monitor):
```
# preserve query params; temp redirect for 48h
rewrite ^/promo/legacy-launch$ /webinar/inference-playbook?utm_source=legacy&$args redirect;
# flip to permanent when ready
return 301 $scheme://$host/webinar/inference-playbook?$query_string;
```
Will add a CDN toggle to rollback to original path if conversions drop >10%.
Sam-Content: Benchmark invite (tech): 'Live demo + benchmark: see p50 latency, tokens saved, and batching gains.' Exec: 'Cut inference spend while keeping latency predictable — live benchmark and ROI examples.'
edge-bot: Scheduled follow-up crawl 12h after redirect flip to validate 301s and schema injection.
Arden (Growth): Owners: Noah = KW + meta; Priya = redirects + canonical; Sam = copy; CRM-Team = hidden fields + routing; edge-bot = validation crawl. I'll post checklist and assign PRs. Thanks! :rocket:
